tools.name: buy_token
tools.description: Buy a token with the chain's native token from the managed GDEX wallet (session-signed purchase_v2). Chains: Ethereum 1, Optimism 10, BSC 56, Sonic 146, Fraxtal 252, Robinhood 4663, Base 8453, Arbitrum 42161, Solana. Returns a requestId; follow it with wait_for_trade. To pay with USDC use usdc_buy.

accountRef.description: Connected account from gdex_connect. Supplies session key, wallet address, API key and session data so no secret is passed in chat

tokenAddress.description: Contract address (mint on Solana) of the token to buy

amount.description: Native token to spend, e.g. '0.1' for 0.1 SOL; converted exactly to native decimals

inputToken.description: Omit, or the chain's native token. Anything else is rejected (use usdc_buy for USDC).

slippage.description: Slippage percent, Solana and Sui only (sent as bps, max 50). Rejected on EVM, where the account's stored slippage applies. Omit to use the stored setting.

priorityFee.description: Solana priority fee in lamports (integer, max 50000000 = 0.05 SOL). Solana only.

dex.description: Not supported: the backend picks the route. Rejected when set.

referrer.description: Not supported by purchase_v2/sell_v2. Rejected when set.

apiKey.description: GDEX API key used to encrypt the signed trade

tools.description: Sell a token for the chain's native token from the managed GDEX wallet (session-signed sell_v2). Amount is a token amount ('100') or a percentage of the held balance ('50%', '100%'), resolved from the managed holdings. Returns a requestId; follow it with wait_for_trade. To receive USDC use usdc_sell.

tools.name: hl_outcomes
tools.description: Discover Hyperliquid HIP-4 outcome markets (GDEX has no Polymarket/Kalshi). Returns normalised markets: outcomeId, title, sides[] (label, coin "#<assetId>", balanceCoin "+<assetId>", price = current mid), quoteToken (collateral, held in the HL spot balance), state (active | pre_launch | expired | settled), rules (price 0.00001-0.99999 tick 0.00001, whole-contract size, min order notional 11 quote), settlement (no claim via GDEX). withVolume=true adds volume24h {volume, asOf, source, coverage} with a bounded wait. raw=true returns the backend payload unchanged.

query.description: Case-insensitive text match on title / side labels / params, or an exact outcomeId

excludeFallback.description: Hide "none of the listed outcomes" legs

sortBy.description: volume: highest 24h volume first (implies withVolume); expiry: soonest first

detail.description: Full market records (rules, params, settlement). Default: compact rows

raw.description: Return the raw backend payload instead

tools.name: get_hl_outcome_volumes
tools.description: Get 24h notional volume per outcome side coin from the Hyperliquid WS feed. Pass coins from hl_outcomes sides[].coin, e.g. ["#143150","#143151"]. Returns { coin: volume } for coins that reported; a missing coin means no reading (not zero). Prefer hl_outcomes withVolume=true, which reports coverage per market.

tools.name: hl_outcome_account
tools.description: Normalised state of a MANAGED wallet on one HIP-4 outcome market: positions (per side: size, hold, available, avgEntryPrice, markPrice, value, unrealizedPnl), openOrders (resting / partially_filled with orderId, price, size, filledSize), fills, historicalOrders (Hyperliquid status). Use it to reconcile after create/cancel/close. raw=true returns the backend payload.

userAddress.description: MANAGED wallet address (outcome balances live there)

tools.name: hl_create_outcome_order
tools.description: Place an order on a Hyperliquid HIP-4 outcome market. Structured mode (apiKey, walletAddress=control address, sessionPrivateKey, outcomeId, one of coin/sideIndex/sideLabel, isBuy, size, and price unless isMarket) is validated against the live market first: side must belong to outcomeId, size is whole contracts, price in [0.00001, 0.99999] with max 5 decimals, size×price >= 11 quote (a full-position sell is exempt when managedAddress is given), market must not be expired/settled. isBuy=false sells side tokens you hold. reduceOnly is ignored by the backend. Returns status resting (with orderId) | filled | rejected. Pre-built mode: computedData alone.

Partial fills before the cancel stay in the position. Pre-built mode: computedData alone.

tools.name: hl_close_outcome_order
tools.description: Exit a HIP-4 outcome position by SELLING held side tokens (the backend always sells; it cannot short). Structured mode: apiKey, walletAddress (control), sessionPrivateKey, outcomeId, one of coin/sideIndex/sideLabel, price (limit) or isMarket=true, optional size (whole contracts; omit for a full exit — the backend caps size to what you hold). Pre-built mode: computedData alone.

tools.name: gdex_connect
tools.description: Connect a GDEX trading account without putting any secret in the conversation. Signs in from a control-wallet key file on this machine (keyFile), or creates a new local wallet (create: true), or refreshes an existing accountRef. Returns an accountRef plus public addresses; pass accountRef to any trading tool instead of sessionPrivateKey/privateKey. Never ask the user to paste a private key or seed phrase.

keyFile.description: Path to a local JSON key file ({ privateKey } or { control: { privateKey } })

create.description: Create and store a new local control wallet (it starts unfunded)

accountRef.description: Refresh the session of an already connected account

tools.name: gdex_accounts
tools.description: List accounts connected on this machine (accountRef, control wallet, managed wallets, session age). No secrets are returned.

tools.name: gdex_disconnect
tools.description: Forget a connected account on this machine (deletes its stored keys). Funds are not affected; reconnect later with gdex_connect and the key file.

accountRef.description: Account to forget

tools.name: gdex_status
tools.description: Start here. Reports version, connected accounts (no secrets), API reachability, delegated trading policy per account, pending operations, supported trade kinds, and the next setup step.

tools.name: gdex_preview_trade
tools.description: Turn an explicit trade intent into exact executable terms without trading: market, side, human and raw amounts, quote source and time, minimum received or limit price, funding plan, expiry (60s). Returns a previewId for gdex_execute_trade. kind=spot (USDC wallet), perp_open, perp_close. For perps give notionalUsd (position size) or marginUsd (collateral), never guess which.

accountRef.description: From gdex_connect

amount.description: spot: USDC to spend (buy) or token amount (sell)

autoFunding.description: spot buy: bridge USDC/gas from other chains (default true)

coin.description: perp: e.g. BTC, or xyz:TSLA for builder DEXes

leverage.description: perp_open: leverage (backend: cross on core perps, isolated on builder-DEX markets)

dex.description: perp_close: builder DEX for a bare coin

tools.name: gdex_execute_trade
tools.description: Execute a preview within the user's authority: userApproved=true only after the user approved THIS preview's terms; otherwise the account's delegated policy must allow it (else status denied). Re-quotes first: moved or expired terms return status revised with a new preview instead of trading. Returns an operation; follow it with gdex_operation. Never call again for the same intent after submission_unknown.

userApproved.description: True only if the user explicitly approved this exact preview

tools.name: gdex_operation
tools.description: Follow or recover an operation by opId: waits for funding/fill (spot streams funding steps; perps check the live position), resolves submission_unknown by looking for the trade instead of resending, and reports needs_retry when the backend offers an in-place sell retry (usdc_retry_sell). Without opId, lists recent operations.

accountRef.description: List filter when no opId

tools.name: gdex_positions
tools.description: What the account owns and has pending: unified USDC + gas balances per chain, Hyperliquid positions on every DEX, open orders, and unfinished operations. Each section says ok or unavailable; unavailable means unknown, not empty.

tools.name: gdex_manage_position
tools.description: Preview an exit for an existing position, against its live state: close/reduce a perp (reduce-only, correct side for longs and shorts) or sell a spot token back to USDC. Returns a preview; execute it with gdex_execute_trade.

tools.name: reverse_engineer_winners
tools.description: Reverse-engineer skill-proven on-chain HyperLiquid wallets into size-invariant forensic patterns — skill-vs-luck scorecards, hold-time/leverage/sizing asymmetry, and prevalence-gated aggregate edges. Read-only. Optional watchlist of wallet addresses to force into the universe.

watchlist.description: Curated wallet addresses to force into the universe (bypass board filters)

max.description: Cap on wallets pulled (board survivors + watchlist). Default 12.
